caption: The drawing depicts a cast iron stove labeled "ZOAR FURNACE" on the upper door. The stove is rectangular with slightly rounded front corners and rests on four curved legs, each ending in a rounded foot. The stove features ornate floral and leaf patterns on its doors and side panels. The front has two square doors—one upper and one lower—both decorated with detailed floral motifs, and each fitted with a latch mechanism. The rounded right-hand side has an additional door, also decorated with a floral motif, and a curved handle. The stove's top is flat with a circular raised section in the center, likely for a stovepipe connection. In front of the stove, there is a flat, oval-shaped metal ash tray or hearth plate that extends outward, resting partly on the wooden platform beneath the stove. The stove and accessories are colored in shades of gray with dark shadows and highlights to suggest metallic surfaces, while the base platform is depicted in brown, resembling wood grain, and includes an inset, patterned metal plate beneath the stove. A thin metal rod with a looped handle lies on the platform beside the stove. The background is off-white with faint brownish spots, and the name "FRITZ BOEPPLE" is printed in small text at the bottom left.
title: Zoar Stove
